attempts.code:
obs = observe()
pen = obs["objects"]["green_pen"]
holder = obs["zones"]["magenta_holder"]
table_z = obs["table_z"]
holder_center = holder["center"]
rim_height = holder.get("rim_height", 0.08)

# The pen is currently partially standing or tilted in/near the holder, center=[-0.0981, 0.1546, 0.8665], height=0.1331.
# Grasp candidate near the top end of the pen so the bottom can insert deep into the holder
cands = grasp_candidates("green_pen")
cands = sorted(cands, key=lambda c: c.get("score", 0), reverse=True)

# Select or adjust candidate to grasp near the top of the pen
cand = cands[0]
for c in cands:
    if c.get("height", 0) > cand.get("height", 0):
        cand = c

# Set grasp height towards the upper part of the pen
cand["height"] = max(cand.get("height", 0.02), pen["height"] - 0.03)

grasp(cand)

safe_z = table_z + rim_height + 0.15
carry_to(holder_center[0], holder_center[1], height=safe_z - table_z)

# Align vertically into holder
candidate_orientations = [
    ([0, 1, 0], [1, 0, 0]),
    ([-1, 0, 0], [0, 1, 0]),
    ([1, 0, 0], [0, 1, 0]),
    ([0, -1, 0], [1, 0, 0]),
]

selected_app, selected_fa = candidate_orientations[0]
for app, fa in candidate_orientations:
    ik_res = solve_ik(holder_center[0], holder_center[1], safe_z, approach=app, finger_axis=fa)
    if ik_res.get("reachable", False):
        selected_app, selected_fa = app, fa
        break

move_gripper(holder_center[0], holder_center[1], safe_z, approach=selected_app, finger_axis=selected_fa, path="line")

lower_target_z = table_z + rim_height + 0.02
move_gripper(holder_center[0], holder_center[1], lower_target_z, approach=selected_app, finger_axis=selected_fa, path="line")

open_gripper()
retreat(dz=0.15)
go_home()
check("green_pen", "magenta_holder")
